description: Customer decision consumer lock storage (CD-09, libs/core/mission/mission-decision-lock.ts): reads the bound tenant's decision case (decisions.jsonl, switches.jsonl, agendas/, consumers/) and writes only consumers/<consumer>.json under knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/decisions/<case>/. Requires an exact deny-only case capability (libs/core/foundation/customer-decision-consumer-capability.ts) naming every path before each operation; tenant-bound (libs/core/authority.ts TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES). No ledger, agenda, receipt, switch, invite or customers/ write authority.
